verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll claims a hire-and-onboard flow that runs "from offer letter to day one" (docs-16). Employees can enter their own personal, direct deposit and tax info online or in the app (docs-13), which covers self-serve W-4 and bank-detail collection before start. Nothing in the evidence mentions I-9 collection or verification; the closest item is generic document upload to employee profiles (docs-12), and nothing independent corroborates how the flow works in practice. Missing for 10: documented I-9 collection and verification, explicit W-4 form handling, detail on sending the onboarding invite to the new hire, independent or hands-on corroboration.
